coverage: All24 original briefs and five contracts read before root announced calls. Eleven copied reference hashes verified afterward; no new artwork or repeat reference viewing performed.

findings.finding: A pulse that has scorched the trailing cape could already be past the fighter when the next image claims she catches its leading front. The hairpin return itself is drawable.
findings.recommended_clarification: Keep the same leading front within lowering-spear reach after it touches only the trailing cape tip; distinguish lower incoming and upper return lanes at the rightmost bronze bend.
findings.strongest_counterexample: A trailing cape tip can cross a still-reachable advancing front; this does not require a different event.

findings.finding: Marked forearm, other counterpunch and near swept knee can swap across cameras when only relational labels are supplied.
findings.recommended_clarification: Lock anatomical sides for the marked forearm, opposite punch and physical knee sweep. Keep high pulse release and low shaft contact distinct.
findings.strongest_counterexample: A delayed forearm impulse and simultaneous shaft sweep are feasible in one frame, with no need to split the reversal.

findings.finding: An orange hook from shoulder to knee can imply the forearm pulse magically travels into the knee, replacing the separate physical sweep.
findings.recommended_clarification: Keep the hook a body-motion accent and expose the actual shaft-to-knee contact, with the ring release attached to its own forearm.
findings.strongest_counterexample: A single rotation accent works if the two real causal relationships remain visible.

overall: No fundamental blocker; three narrow clarifications recommended. NG contact/left-arm cost, BP cover/lure/cut and IO brace-slip/short-lever/flank consequence form coherent intended arcs. Actual art must establish them.
timing_disclosure: The three original findings were sent to root against the original SHA before calls. Root revised the plan while this file was being prepared; an assertion prevented falsely binding the revised bytes to the original SHA. This report preserves the original observations; the separate addendum verifies the revised plan.
exposure: Root specifically requested SB03 and ST03 attention. Independent textual preflight, not blind or pixel acceptance.
